title: The Day the Storm Came
text: Picture that day, as the researchers do. A storm probably built over the coast, and rain poured into the rivers.
nxt: A flood of muddy fresh water rushed out into the bay, and the fish, adapted to the sea, could not cope.

title: Reading a Crushed Fossil
text: Fossils are not photographs. Rock presses on them for hundreds of millions of years, and shells and plates get flattened or broken.
nxt: A palaeontologist has to work out the original shape from the pieces, and they do it by comparing many specimens.

title: Evolution Is Not a Ladder
text: Sacabambaspis also helps correct a common picture. Evolution is not a ladder with fish at the bottom and humans at the top.
nxt: It is more like a bush, with many branches, side paths, and endings. Being on a branch that ends does not make a species a failure.
